expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you', 'Use code TALLINN3...', 'Order now' outline) is white/light on a pale mint-green background, giving very low contrast and poor readability, especially in bright environments and for low-vision users.
Several food thumbnails (e.g., 'Smash Bros Burgers', 'Trattoria Piccola', 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar') appear blurry or overly soft, suggesting low-resolution or poorly scaled images.
The delivery fee captions ('€0.90 delivery', '€2.40 delivery', '€1.90 delivery') are rendered in very light gray, which is low contrast against the white background.
